text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Concentration of ozone in the stratosphere
Stratospheric ozone concentration in the Southern Hemisphere – based on satellite measurements at a latitude
south of 40°S. This is measured in Dobson Units (DU).

tspan.tspan: "Minimum daily mean" is the average daily minimum ozone concentration between 21st September and 16th October, when the

text.tspan: Antarctic ozone hole is typically biggest.
